newsitem.title: USA: Metro Information names fifth director.
newsitem.headline: Metro Information names fifth director.

text.p: Metro Information Services Inc said Tuesday A. Eugene Loving Jr has been elected to its Board of Directors, increasing the board to five members from four.

Loving is chairman and chief executive officer of Max Media Properties LLC, a diversified radio and television broadcast company. Loving will also serve on the audit and compensation committees of the board. Before being a founder of Max Media, he served as chairman of TVX Broadcast Group.
